summary: Feature 93 adds exact ordered LTL values and all seven options for original EventLog filtering, plus exact Heuristics protected pairs and all 24 options. Original DFG inputs retain all 14 fields; native HeuristicsNet results retain all 35 fields and separate export errors. Validation passed 60 selected API cases across 61 requests, 20 CLI invocations, four public-client successes across six requests preserving seven original Files, two live checks, and 9393 frontend tests. Two real defects were fixed: mining status metadata and the client guard for an existing EventStream carrier. Both product failures were rerun once; successful outcomes were retained. A separate invalid cached-selector input was corrected without replaying either successful client outcome. An additional cached-stream oracle supplements 20 retained native cases. Native evidence covers 89 passing suites (85 retained plus four fresh executions) and 217 core objects. Functional evidence totals 69 POSTs, or 71 including two before-change observations. Strict parity remains unfinished: 228 catalogue units are incomplete. Browser access was rejected by tool policy despite user-enabled settings, so zero rendered UI checks completed.
